outcome: Maternal admission to intensive care unit (ICU)
Admission to special care nursery/neonatal intensive care unit (SCN/NICU)
finding: Social disadvantage was associated with higher odds of adverse perinatal outcomes, including maternal ICU admission, PPH, perinatal mortality, and neonatal SCN/NICU admission, preterm birth, and LBW.
mod_finding: This study found an association between social disadvantage and higher odds of caesarean section, alongside other adverse perinatal outcomes.
